name: Diesel-Skull War-Horde
identity: Scrap-mech brutes, speed-maniac bikers and huge, inaccurate mobs. Buckets of bad dice that explode on 6s, and one battle-defining round of Scrap-Fury when the whole horde surges forward.

rules.name: Dakka & Scrap-Fury
rules.description: Dakka: Diesel-Skull ranged weapons have [ASSAULT]; unmodified Hit rolls of 6 with them are critical and score 1 extra hit ([ONSLAUGHT 1]). Scrap-Fury (once per battle): declare in the Command Phase — until the End of Round, Diesel-Skull units get +1 Attack in melee and +2″ to Charge rolls.

rules.name: Gamble — Overcrank the Engine
rules.description: When a Class 2–5 vehicle or bike unit activates, roll a D6: 1 the engine seizes (D3 Fatal Wounds, no Move this activation) · 2–3 +2″ MOV · 4–5 +4″ MOV · 6 +4″ MOV and +1 Attack in melee. (Risk: durability (dice).)

detachments.name: Speed-Cult
detachments.playstyle: Bikes, buggies and wagons: everything fast, everything ramming.

rules.name: Ramming Speed
rules.description: Class 2–5 vehicles and bikes get +2″ MOV and trigger Crushing Impact for 0 CP on the charge.

stratagems.name: Full Throttle
stratagems.turn: A vehicle or bike unit activates
stratagems.effect: Overcrank without rolling a 1 (re-roll a result of 1).

stratagems.name: Wreck Run
stratagems.effect: Before removal it moves 6″ and explodes: D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+ to every unit within 6″.

stratagems.name: Drive-By
stratagems.turn: A vehicle or bike unit Shoots
stratagems.effect: It may make a 3″ move after shooting.

detachments.name: Bully Mobs
detachments.playstyle: Big mobs and brutes in a single shouting wave.

rules.name: Mob Rule
rules.description: Class 1 units with 10+ models get +1 to Hit in melee and cannot be Rattled.

enhancements.name: Boss-Pole
enhancements.description: **Iron-Jaw Brute Boss** only. Friendly Class 1 units within 6″ get +1 to Hit in melee.

stratagems.name: Get In There!
stratagems.turn: A Class 1 unit declares a Charge

stratagems.name: More Lads
stratagems.effect: Return D6 slain models to a Class 1 unit within 6″ of your table edge.

detachments.name: Tinker-Workshop
detachments.playstyle: Scrap-walkers, artillery and surgeons bolting things on.

rules.name: Kustom Jobs
rules.description: At deployment, give up to 3 Class 2–5 units one upgrade each: +1 Attack on one weapon · +1 PEN on one weapon · UNYIELDING 6+.

enhancements.name: Kustom Force-Field
enhancements.description: **Scrap-Surgeon** only. Friendly units within 6″ get +1 ARM (to 3+ cap) against ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: Overcharged Kannon
stratagems.effect: +1 Damage; on a natural 1 to Hit it suffers 1 Fatal Wound.
